name: hs_ms_bussing_1mi
description: Re-add high-school basic yellow-bus service AND shrink both middle-school and high-school walk zones from the 2-mile rule to 1 mile (calibrated buffers). Combines ms_walk_1mi and hs_bussing_1mi: every secondary student more than a mile out becomes bus-eligible. Same HS-as-fraction-of-MS propensity model and caveat as hs_bussing (x0.7 independent transit, grades 11-12 additionally x0.5).
